title: Bones
description:
S08 E07 — The Bod in the Pod
A pod containing the remains of a crime-scene cleaner washes onto a beach; Angela and Hodgins learn a secret about Cam.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E08 — The But in the Joke
When a street artist falls into his own adhesive, he also lands on human remains that stay glued to his body; Booth searches a comedy club for suspects.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E17 — Swift, Silent, Deadly
A highly skilled special operations Marine assaults six men in a bar, sending the NCIS team on a city-wide manhunt.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E18 — Slay the Dragon
Tammy is reunited with her ex-husband, Ethan McKinley - who embezzled millions in Katrina relief funds - after he's tied to the murder of a crime boss' son.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E19 — Quid Pro Quo
A deadly accident at a naval base exposes a unit of Seabees to a super virus and leaves the rest of the base and the city of New Orleans at risk for an outbreak; Wade is infected with the virus and given hours to live.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E20 — NOLA Confidential
LaSalle must investigate his former partner in the Vice unit after the NCIS team finds a link between an international drug ring and the New Orleans Police Department; Rita looks into a connection between the mayor and illegal activity in Clearwater.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E21 — Krewe
Pride listens in on a wiretap of Mayor Hamilton; the NCIS team investigates when Navy weapons get stolen in a train heist; featuring musical performances by Sheryl Crow.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E22 — Knockout
The murder of a Navy chaplain leads Pride to uncover a possible connection between Mayor Hamilton and illegal activity taking place in the city of Clearwater; Percy continues to face repercussions of her choices on a previous case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E23 — Down the Rabbit Hole
When Pride is spotted tracking one of Mayor Hamilton's accomplices on a crowded street, the suspect opens fire, putting innocent lives at risk before disappearing.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E24 — Poetic Justice
Unable to trust anyone in New Orleans, the NCIS team calls in FBI Assistant Director Isler to help expose and stop Mayor Hamilton's sinister scheme.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E20 — Ha'alele
Max reveals shocking information about his childhood to help the team track a serial killer who may have ties to Max's past.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E21 — Pa Make Loa
When a suspect threatens to release a deadly virus, the Five-0 teams up with Special Agents G. Callen (Chris O'Donnell) and Sam Hanna (LL Cool J).

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E22 — Ua Hopu
When McGarrett finally gets to Wo Fat, he is stunned to learn that the Japanese Yakuza wants them both dead.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E23 — Ua Hala
The team goes on a manhunt when one of its own is killed; a team member must choose which one of their kidnapped loved ones will survive.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E01 — La O Na Makuahine
Following the murder of an important family member, the team searches for Delano and Wo Fat.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E02 — Kanalua
McGarrett asks Catherine to help find his mother; the teams seek assistance from August March (Edward Asner) with a deadly art heist.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E03 — Lana I Ka Moana
Danny and McGarrett's day at sea takes a deadly turn when their boat is hijacked.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E04 — Popilikia
McGarrett's mom pays him an unexpected visit while the team investigates a polo player's death.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E05 — Mohai
As the team investigates a grisly murder, evidence suggests the killer is about to strike again.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E06 — I Ka Wa Mamua
Danny must hold completely still as technicians disarm a bomb he accidentally activated; McGarrett tries to distract his partner by sharing a story about a tough case.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E07 — Ohuna
The murder of a computer hacker prompts an investigation, and McGarrett tries to stage a reunion.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E08 — Wahine'inoloa
McGarrett thinks a smart, seductive therapist (Vanessa Marcil) murdered one of her patients; one of Doris' former targets seeks revenge.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E09 — Ha'awe Make Loa
A botched robbery puts Max and his crush (Rumer Willis) in danger; when a stalker targets a supermodel, Danny must come to her rescue.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E10 — Huaka'I Kula
McGarrett and a little girl are taken hostage by an armed man (Tom Arnold) during a camping trip with Grace; Kono meets Adam's brother, who was recently released from prison.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E11 — Kahu
McGarret and Catherine meet a boy whose father is missing and could be in grave danger.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S03 E12 — Kapu
When a professor is murdered, his boss, his teaching assistant and a student all come under suspicion.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E09 — Love's a Bitch
The murder of a British spy may be linked to an adulterous dating site.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E10 — The Long Con
Toby and Michelle team up with a con artist to catch a human trafficker.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E11 — House of Horrors
An actor is murdered while filming an alleged cursed horror movie.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E12 — False I.D.
The police superintendent interferes with the capture of a murder suspect.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E12 — Sister City: Part Two
Special Agent Pride and the team investigate a Russian sleeper agent involved with Abby's brother; Sebastian goes to Washington, D.C., to work with Abby; Bishop drives all night to deliver a package and help the New Orleans team.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E13 — Undocumented
The staged suicide of a petty officer turns out to be murder; the team secretly works on an online dating profile for Pride.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E14 — Father's Day
A Mardi Gras celebration at Pride's bar is cut short when he and Mayor Douglas Hamilton (Steven Weber) are abducted by unknown assailants.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E15 — No Man's Land
Evidence suggests that the man responsible for saving a lieutenant's life is a soldier who was captured in Afghanistan.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E16 — Second Chances
Special Agent Pride and the team uncover a domestic drug ring -- led by Sonja's childhood friend, Marion Watkins (Samaire Armstrong), that is producing cocaine.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E17 — Radio Silence
A Navy captain is murdered during an appearance on a local radio show; Pride's daughter comes home to talk about her plans for the future.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E18 — If It Bleeds, It Leads
Agent Brody sees a connection between the case of a sailor struck by a party bus and the death of her sister; the team gets ready for the city's St. Patrick's Day celebrations.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E19 — Means to an End
After Pride's daughter is attacked on campus, the team finds a surveillance van loaded with pictures of the special agent's every move.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E20 — Second Line
The team investigates when a Navy lieutenant is murdered during a traditional funeral procession in the French Quarter honoring the recently deceased.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E21 — Collateral Damage
When a Navy lieutenant dies during a secret visit to a general's hotel, agent Pride and the team are asked to break protocol for the investigation.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E22 — Help Wanted
While visiting her family's restaurant in the French Quarter, a Navy culinary specialist is the target of an explosion; in D.C., Brody tracks a lead in the Gen. Leak case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E23 — The Third Man
NCIS teams with Homeland Security when the murder of a Navy master diver is discovered to be linked to the chatter concerning a foreign attack on the city.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E24 — Sleeping With the Enemy
The NCIS team discovers a mole in the ranks while helping the Department of Homeland Security locate 900 pounds of missing explosives that are a threat to New Orleans.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E01 — Aftershocks
The team joins forces with several federal agencies to stop a sniper who has been targeting crowded events in the city; FBI Special Agent Tammy Gregorio begins investigating Pride's team.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E02 — Suspicious Minds
Pride faces more repercussions from the FBI after he helps a former Navy Intelligence Analyst who is the primary suspect in a multiple homicide case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E03 — Man on Fire
After the discovery of a petty officer's body inside a sports arena, evidence leads Pride and the NCIS team to a kidnapping case of another petty officer, last seen in Mexico.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E04 — Escape Plan
The NCIS must come to the rescue of one of its own when Sebastian is kidnapped while dining in a restaurant with his mother; Sebastian relies on his gaming skills in a prison break.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E05 — Course Correction
The NCIS and the FBI investigate a private plane crash in the bayou that killed three sailors; Sonja and LaSalle interview candidates for a job opening on the team.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E06 — One Good Man
A Navy SEAL candidate is murdered weeks before his graduation; Wade seeks Pride's help when her adopted son announces his plan to join the Navy.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E07 — Outlaws
A sailor is murdered during a rowdy motorcycle rally in the city; LaSalle seeks personal advice from Gregorio.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E02 — Single Point of Failure
The team is called upon by the governor when a virus leaves his daughter with only 24 hours to live; Walter receives a letter about his sister.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E03 — A Cyclone
After failing a military training mission, the team members are determined to prove themselves when an Internet infrastructure is threatened by a bomber.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E04 — Shorthanded
The members of the team disregard Cabe's advice and go to Las Vegas for a casino job; a robbery leads to Walter being arrested.

title: Scorpion
description:
S01 E05 — Plutonium Is Forever
Walter and the team ask a troubled former associate for help when a nuclear reactor in Los Angeles is on the verge of a cataclysmic meltdown.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E12 — Ihea 'Oe I Ka Wa a Ka Ua E Loku Ana?
When a list of undercover CIA agents is stolen, the team enlists the help of Magnum, Higgins, Rick and TC to get it back and protect national security; Higgins gives Tani some personal advice.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E13 — Loa'a Pono Ka 'Iole I Ka Punana
Grover and the team investigate a murder at a private golf course involving a man who was frozen to death in the locker room's cryotherapy chamber; McGarrett tags along with Danny when he tracks down the father of a boy who has been bullying Charlie.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E14 — I Ho'olulu, Ho'ohulei 'Ia E Ka Makani
Soon after Danny meets the girl of his dreams, they get into a potentially fatal car accident in an area far from help; McGarrett enlists Quinn and Tani to help when Eddie the dog suddenly shows signs of post-traumatic stress disorder.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E15 — He Waha Kou o Ka He'e
When Grover's niece goes missing from the police academy, it's discovered that her boyfriend is an undercover member of the yakuza.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E16 — He Kauwa ke Kanaka na ke Aloha
On Valentine's Day, Tani and Noelani are held hostage during a convenience store robbery; the team investigates the murder of a Thai diplomat whose wife confesses to the crime, but Danny suspects she's covering for the real killer.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E17 — He Kohu Puahiohio I Ka Ho'olele I Ka Lepo I Luna
Harry Langford helps Five-0 investigate some murders that follow the plot of a fabled, unpublished crime novel from the 1920s; Tani and Junior's friendship takes a meaningful new turn.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E18 — Nalowale I Ke 'Ehu O He Kai
The team investigates a murder on a cargo ship where pirates impersonated the Coast Guard to board the boat; Adam finally gets the evidence he needs to take down the island's Yakuza operation once and for all.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E19 — E Ho'i Na Keiki Oki Uaua O Na Pali
A rancher is murdered after he uncovers human skeletons where legend says that Civil War-era gold coins are buried; Quinn's former stepdaughter reaches out to her for help after her father doesn't come home.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E20 — He Puhe'e Miki
The team investigates a scheme to rob tourists; Tani helps Girard Hirsch prove the innocence of his elderly uncle when he's suspected of murder; Tani and Junior work on the nuances of being in a new relationship.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E21 — 'Ohe ia e Loa'a Aku, He Ulua Kapapa No Ka Moana
After Steve receives a posthumous letter from his mother that contains a cypher, Danny is attacked by someone willing to kill to steal it; Five-0 must help an anonymous good Samaritan who's in the crosshairs of some very dangerous people.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E22 — Aloha
Danny is abducted and badly wounded by Wo Fat's wife, who is after the cypher Steve's mother left him; Steve finally solves the case his father left for him 10 years ago.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
Steve McGarrett, a decorated Naval officer, returns to Hawaii to investigate his father's murder and is asked to head up an elite police task force.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E02 — Ohana
Following the abduction of a former NSA cyberterrorism expert, the team must rescue the man and prevent a breach of national security.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E03 — Malama Ka Aina
An escalating gang war spills into the stands of a high-school football game, killing several people; an unlikely partnership arises.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E04 — Lanakila
A violent convict escapes from prison and kidnaps a young couple on vacation; McGarrett's estranged sister comes to town.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E05 — Nalowale
When the daughter of the U.S. ambassador to the Philippines is found dead, the governor tasks Five-0 with finding her abducted sister.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E06 — Ko'olauloa
When the CEO of a successful surf company is murdered, Kono revisits her past; Five-0 is thrown into the varied but interconnected worlds of North Shore surfing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E07 — Ho'apono
A Navy SEAL accused of murder takes hostages and safe haven on a memorial battleship.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E08 — Mana'o
When Danny's ex-partner is found dead at a Hawaiian luau the Five-0 team's investigation leads them to some dirty cops and a powerful cocaine cartel.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E09 — Po'ipu
The team must protect a ruthless dictator from an assassination.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E04 — Windmill + Acetone + Celluloid + Firing Pin
As MacGyver works quickly to rescue survivors from a collapsed building in Germany, he discovers a new safety threat -- an undetonated bomb from World War II is hidden beneath the rubble.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E05 — Soccer + Desi + Merchant + Titan
In an attempt to find the main players in the Codex and cut off their match-fixing funding, Desi goes undercover to infiltrate a soccer team and find the corrupt player working with the shadow organization.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E06 — Right + Wrong + Both + Neither
When Russ' first love, Emilia, is kidnapped by the same rebels he fought during his private military contract days, he takes the Phoenix team to a small, impoverished town to rescue her and rid the town of the rebels for good.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E07 — Mac + Desi + Riley + Aubrey
A double date descends into chaos when Mac and Desi witness a murder in the back of the restaurant; as they work to find the killer, Riley tries to keep the secret about her and her friends' "day jobs" from her new boyfriend.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E08 — Father + Son + Father + Matriarch
After Oversight is almost killed in a bombing, he recruits Mac to help him find the suspected bomber; Mac meets his Aunt Gwendolyn.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E09 — Code + Artemis + Nuclear + N3mesis
Los Angeles' power grid is taken hostage in a ransomware attack resulting in a citywide blackout; the team discovers the ransomware code used was written by Riley years ago.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E10 — Tesla + Bell + Edison + Mac
When Mac is put into a dream state to help him recall key evidence found in Nikola Tesla's secret lab that could stop Codex's deadly plot, he encounters Nikola Tesla, Alexander Graham Bell, Thomas Edison and his mother.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E11 — Psy-Op + Cell + Merchant + Birds
Mac is placed inside a fake prison cell with a top Codex operative, "The Merchant," to gain his trust and get intel on their next move.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E14 — All That Remains
When an author's daughter goes missing on the anniversary of his wife's disappearance, the team investigates the author as a possible suspect.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E15 — Broken
The team heads to Austin to investigate when victims with watches set to inaccurate times are discovered; the team's stalker gets closer.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S08 E16 — Carbon Copy
Victims of the Replicator, the BAU's stalker, turn up in Philadelphia; the members of the team think they are getting close to apprehending their suspect.
